lines.text: You wrote a great launch plan, and your teammates really need to see it. But your other drafts are not ready for anyone.
Without control you face a bad trade. Hand over the whole board, or email a copy and watch it go stale.
Agent R Q Teams fixes that. You belong to a team, like your platform team, and your workspaces can be shared with it.
In the Pano, open the launch plan. The share control sits right on the doc page, so there is nowhere else to go.
Choose to share with a team, pick the platform team, and press share.
Only the launch plan moves. The half baked ideas and the salary notes never leave your account.
Your teammates read it on the team Pano. Comments and checklists come along with the doc.
They cannot edit it. Your words stay yours, and nobody can change the plan behind your back.
Their agents can read the doc as well. So a teammate agent picks up the plan, and starts on the checklist.
And you stay in control. Unshare the doc whenever you like, and your teammates lose access at once.
Share the next doc the same way, one at a time, and only when you decide it is ready.
Which doc would you share with your team first? Tell us in the comments, and try Teams at Agent R Q dot com.
